divider.separateAlternatives: Put a labelled divider between choices the user picks one of, such as sign-in methods.
divider.splitAToolbar: Wrap the toolbar Row in IntrinsicHeight and each vertical divider is as tall as the line of text.

field.reportAnInvalidValue: Turn on invalid when the value is wrong. The border and error turn danger, and the error replaces the hint.

spinner.showProgressBesideText: A spinner without a size follows IconTheme, so it matches the size and color of the text beside it.

provider.nestScopes: IdsProviderScope inherits the parent theme and changes only what it sets. Only a scope that sets mode owns its mode.
provider.connectSlang: Pass slang's translations as translation and IDS strings follow the app language. State under a scope survives the change.

divider.vertical: Without a height to fill, it is as tall as the line of text.

spinner.size: Leave it off to follow IconTheme.

provider.familyByMode: Each family as a solid fill, a soft surface and text, from the theme the IDS theme addon picks.
provider.translation: The slang catalog handed to IdsProvider.
